requirement: Transform the man’s phone call in the beige leather car interior into digital glitch art, with high-contrast shadows and RGB color separation across his navy suit, seats, and window reflections. Apply horizontal pixel shifts, fragmented blocks, and flickering scan-line textures across the entire frame, with distorted color highlights.
annotation_note: Retrospective development evaluation. Source timeline reviewed before this scoring run; outputs already existed. Not a prospective held-out annotation.
scene_summary: 男子在米色皮质汽车后座持黑色手机贴耳通话，穿深色西装及白衬衫，头部、嘴部有细小动作。
allowed_changes: 按要求让全画面呈现高反差、RGB 分离、像素横移、碎片方块和闪烁扫描线。
允许有意的通道重影、局部位移及色彩高光变化；仍需辨认原男子、手机通话和车内关系。
